scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind designing two clear slides.
Slide: is one screen of a presentation. Theme: gives slides a coordinated design.
Transition: controls how one slide changes to another. Animation: makes an object appear or move. Presenter: speaks clearly while showing the slides.
Make a one-page paper example about your school or a Ghanaian festival. Include slide, theme and transition; present it clearly to a partner.
